_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: Abandoned detail loading is cleared without applying its late result. The VM has four integrations: gh, llm (with provider details), notify and reflection. The page's first request for gh's details waits until call "release". Call "gh details asked" says whether the page has asked for gh's details ("true" or "false"); call "old details answered" whether the held answer has been sent. Name elements by ARIA role and accessible name, as Playwright's getByRole does; "named X" means an exact name match. "The modal" is ".integrations-modal". To "open the panel": press Control+k; ".command-palette-input" should be visible; fill it with "integration", click the first ".command-palette-item", and the modal should be visible. To "select" an integration N: click the first ".integrations-tabs button" (the list), then the ".integrations-name-btn" whose text starts with N followed by a space; ".integrations-detail-head strong" should then have exactly the text N. "The refresh button" is the modal's button named "Refresh"; "the Slack test button" is the button named "Test integration (webhook only)"; "the notify button" is the button named "Send test notification". To "close the modal": click the modal's button whose name contains "Close modal". To "start": navigate to /new, wait for the element with data-testid "message-input" to be visible, and open the panel. Perform the steps in order. 1. Start, and select gh. 2. Call "gh details asked" until it returns "true". 3. Close the modal, then open the panel again. There should be exactly 4 ".integrations-name-btn", and the refresh button should be enabled. 4. Call "release", then call "old details answered" until it returns "true". 5. Select llm. ".integrations-providers-table" should be visible, and there should be no ".integrations-guide" (count 0).
